title: Prototype symptomatic gallstone evidence for elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy review
organization: Society of American Gastrointestinal and Endoscopic Surgeons (SAGES)
source_revision: January 2010; publication date listed in the SAGES guideline index

applicable_service.procedure: Elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy for symptomatic gallstones

criteria_for_future_evaluation.concept: Submitted clinical evidence explicitly describes symptoms attributed to gallstones, rather than asymptomatic incidental stones. This represents the symptomatic component of SAGES section III, not independent diagnosis or full surgical candidacy.

Submitted evidence explicitly documents gallstones, the stone component of symptomatic cholelithiasis in SAGES section III. Clinical assertions or diagnostic findings may support this criterion; an imaging document's presence alone cannot. Do not infer stones from abdominal pain or a procedure request alone.

scope_context.included_scope: Criterion-level evidence preparation for the symptomatic gallstone indication in section III (Indications), for an elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy request. The two criteria separate symptoms attributed to stones from explicit stone documentation; they do not establish medical necessity or operative eligibility.
excluded_scopes: Full surgical candidacy, anesthesia tolerance, cardiopulmonary fitness and other contraindication assessment remain for the human expert; absence of such information does not establish fitness.
Other gallbladder disease, biliary dyskinesia, common bile duct disease and emergency surgery management
Operative technique, antibiotic selection, perioperative and postoperative management
Insurer document requirements, coverage and final authorization decisions

provenance.source_organization: Society of American Gastrointestinal and Endoscopic Surgeons (SAGES)
provenance.source_document: Guidelines for the Clinical Application of Laparoscopic Biliary Tract Surgery
provenance.source_clinical_scenario: Section III: Indications; symptomatic cholelithiasis only. Source publication date confirmed at https://www.sages.org/publications/guidelines/ (January 2010); accessed 2026-10-04.
provenance.representation_note: This is a prototype structured representation derived from the cited source, not an official SAGES guideline artifact or a complete reproduction. Criteria are concise paraphrases of components of the symptomatic gallstone indication, not additional guideline-mandated eligibility tests. Verify the representation against the authoritative source before production use.
provenance.guidance_scope_note: Evidence support prepares the case for human expert review only. Final clinical and authorization judgments remain human. The source discusses anesthesia tolerance and comorbidities; this narrow prototype does not assess them or declare surgery medically necessary. SAGES section III does not impose a submitted ultrasound-report requirement: report completeness belongs to separate deterministic document rules.
